name: 06812 · New Fairfield, CT
findings: ZIP 06812 (New Fairfield) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06812 (New Fairfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06812 (New Fairfield) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
